verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for an AI assistant app, but the evidence pack never documents a control to disable telemetry or usage tracking. Item 89 mentions that "ChatGPT data controls" exist without saying what they do. The /memories toggle and admin access controls are adjacent features, not telemetry opt-outs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
